depiction_rules.notes: Keep the same single adversary through S001–S008, changing posture and expression with the action. Preserve the mature face and full greying beard and moustache observed in the D011 S009 identity reference. He is distinct from the gathered gods and sages.

visual_bible.face: One recognizable mature older adult face matching the D011 S009 identity reference: strong brow, expressive eyes, long wavy dark hair, and a full long greying beard and moustache. Keep the beard visibly greying and full in every D013 appearance; action may alter expression but not apparent age, beard coverage, or facial identity. No clean-shaven, moustache-only, or entirely dark-beard variation. No monster mouth or horror distortion.
visual_bible.body: Large athletic adult proportions, exactly two attached arms and two legs; hands remain distinct when gripping a mace or trident.
visual_bible.skin: Muted maroon or burnt-sienna mineral tones that contrast clearly with Varaha’s reddish/deep-brown boar fur and orange/ochre ornaments; do not make Varaha blue-grey.
visual_bible.clothing: Simple asura warrior garment and restrained painted ornaments; use the same cues throughout the D013 sequence.
visual_bible.weapons: A mace in S004–S005 and a trident in S006 only when called for by the scene.

never: no glossy metallic or cinematic treatment

continuity_reference.authority: identity only; not pose, weapon, body-form, or approved-master authority

note: This is a D013 working continuity rule, not an approved character sheet or artwork approval.
